title: Market Health: looking past the index
excerpt: The S&P 500 is weighted by size, so a few giant companies can carry it. Market Health ignores size and counts stocks one by one. It shows breadth, the share of stocks in an uptrend, across all the stocks we track, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq-100. Updated every evening after the market closes. It describes the market as it is today. It is not a forecast and it is not a signal for any single stock.
intro:
The S&P 500 is weighted by size, so a few giant companies can carry it. Market Health ignores size and counts stocks one by one.

Breadth is the share of stocks in an uptrend. We show two readings: long-term and short-term.

Three views. All the stocks we track, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq-100.

Five plain descriptions. Broad advance, Mixed, Narrowing, Washed out and Recovering. Each one is set by fixed rules, so the label never depends on anyone's opinion.

Updated every evening after the market closes.

Market Health describes the market as it is today. It is not a forecast and it is not a signal for any single stock.

The page is open to everyone, no sign-in needed.
